answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lantern of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The shale is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the summit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, expired if not renewed by fresh work, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
